title: Brugada Eliminates Interest on All Fondeso Loans, Announces Entrepreneurship Institute
detail: On November 5 Clara Brugada announced that all loans from the CDMX development fund Fondeso will carry a 0% interest rate, so borrowers repay only principal. Loans under 30,000 pesos were already interest-free; larger ones carried 3% annually. The announcement also included an Instituto del Emprendimiento, and Excélsior reported the government is preparing a public Banco de la CDMX. Implementation rules, including treatment of existing loans, were not yet confirmed.

media.caption: Brugada eliminates interest on Fondeso loans
